title: Casper

entries.claim: Sites A–E fit the generator; sites F and G form a held-out region.
entries.reason: The original private cohort, schema and individual records are unavailable.
entries.qualification: Site routing is implemented. The cohort and its schema, counts and provenance are unavailable for validation.

entries.claim: Early gastric cancer or high-grade intraepithelial neoplasia within 12 months is the primary outcome.
entries.reason: Clinical event and pathology data and outcome extraction rules are unavailable.
entries.qualification: The loader accepts a precomputed binary outcome but cannot verify histology, time-window logic or exclusions from the data provided.

entries.claim: A mixed-type generator combines a masked autoencoder with guided diffusion.
entries.reason: Complete model architecture, training objective and settings are not specified; no official implementation is identified.

entries.claim: Calculate per-record gradients, clip their global norm and average.
entries.qualification: Clipping and averaging are present; the loss and per-record gradients are unspecified.

entries.claim: Add Gaussian noise to the mean gradient with standard deviation sigma times C.
entries.qualification: The caller supplies the standard deviation; no epsilon, delta or privacy guarantee is calculated.

entries.claim: Calibrate the noise and maintain a site ledger.
entries.reason: Sampling scheme and accountant details required for calibration are not specified.

entries.claim: Retain the largest fraction of update coordinates.
entries.qualification: Rounding upward and tie handling are explicit engineering defaults.

entries.claim: Quantize and securely mask site updates, aggregate and broadcast.
entries.reason: Quantizer, mask protocol, security assumptions and handling of dropouts are not specified. A zero-sum mask alone does not establish site privacy.

entries.claim: Compare a privacy loss accountant with a Renyi accountant.
entries.reason: Accountants, sampling, composition, calibration parameters and released transcript are not specified.

entries.qualification: Metric code was previously checked against an independent library; the manuscript cohort remains unavailable.

entries.claim: Report the median Kolmogorov–Smirnov statistic across fields.
entries.qualification: The two-sample per-field statistic is implemented; mixed-field aggregation and paper results are not verified.
A standard binary threshold formula is implemented; the paper does not specify code or reportable data.

entries.claim: Compare arms, attacks, clinical outcomes and site-level results, with site-clustered intervals and 20 random seeds.
entries.reason: Cohort, models, predictions, attack setup and full analysis protocol are unavailable.
The source appendix omits parts of the formal setting, assumptions and proofs; its relations are not independently established.

entries.claim: The manuscript describes a deposit with a persistent identifier and open licence.
entries.reason: The supplied document gives no dataset identifier, link or licence.

entries.claim: Missingness is reported for the cohort.
entries.qualification: Missing-cell counting is implemented; the cohort values and missingness rates remain unverified.

engineering_defaults: Numeric CSV input requires explicit column names and finite numeric cells.
Sparsification rounds the number of coordinates upward and resolves equal magnitudes by index order.
The retrospective CSV schema is explicitly supplied by the caller; missing fields are preserved, not imputed.
Only retrospective sites A–G are accepted, and both fitting and external partitions must be present.
The outcome field must already contain a known 0/1 value; its clinical derivation is not inferred.
source_note: The manuscript cites TabMAGD, available at https://doi.org/10.26599/BDMA.2025.9020105. This citation does not establish the exact generator or training configuration used in the manuscript.
